💡 Quick Guide — Image MCQ

Upload a question image (diagram, chart, photo or text-as-image). Type up to 6 answer choices — leave blank if choices are printed inside the image itself. Tick the correct answer, set marks & time, then click ➕ Add Question. Works for any subject: Science diagrams, Geography maps, Maths graphs, English texts, History timelines and more.

📐 Maths 🔬 Science 🌍 Geography 📚 English 🏛 History 🎨 Art

🔧 MCQ Format Helper — Prepare Text for Panel B

Got raw MCQ text in an unsupported format? Paste it here and click Format — it will be converted into the exact format accepted by the 🤖 AI Smart Paste box above, with the correct answer marked by *.

Supports: numbered questions (1. / 1)), options on same line or separate lines, correct answer marked with *, (correct), (✓), or (Answer: A).

🤖 AI Smart Paste — Cloze Detection

Paste a passage with blanks as ___ (underscores), (___), or [1] [2]. The parser converts them to gap markers automatically.

🔤 Panel C — Fill-in-Gaps (Cloze)

Use [1] [2] [3]... to mark gaps. Max 8 gaps.

      🤖 AI Smart Paste — Short Answer

      Paste questions with accepted key phrases. Format: Question on one line, then "Keys:" followed by comma-separated key phrases, then "Answer:" for the model answer. Or paste a Q&A list and the parser will extract them automatically.

      Student earns marks if answer contains any key phrase (case-insensitive).
